sources.locator: "Eleições legislativas regionais na Madeira em 2024", revision 71818912

explanation: A corruption investigation and a resignation caused the snap election of May 2024. The ballot of September 2023 fixed when it could happen. The constitution forbids the president from dissolving a legislative assembly within six months of its election, so nothing could be done between Albuquerque's resignation on 5 February and the dissolution on 27 March. A region governed by a resigned cabinet waited seven weeks for a clock to run out. The edge argues that limit, which is why it is `precondition-of`.
